title: Separate AuthProvider and TransportConfig traits: any auth composes with any TLS config
description: Auth credential injection (Authorization header) and TLS/transport configuration (trust roots, client certs, connect timeout) are split into two separate traits. This allows CustomCaTransport + BearerAuth, DefaultTransport + BasicAuth, or NoneAuth + any custom transport without combinatorial implementations. A contributor might suggest collapsing them into a single 'ClientConfig' or 'ConnectionConfig' trait to reduce the number of types. That would require a separate implementation for every (transport, auth) combination or a single god-object. The orthogonal design is correct; the blanket impls for Box<dyn> and Arc<dyn> handle the erasure case.
